properties.description: 2026-09-11, after PR #475. The vocabulary half of criterion 1, ruled as option (b) in dec:a-tool-carries-the-users-phrasing-and-the-corpus-is-the-test: every served tool whose description lacked the words a user states its job in gained one sentence carrying them, written from purpose; five over-budget descriptions were trimmed to make room; and the 180-query corpus became a committed acceptance test with three measured exemptions. Measured: 120 → 177 of 180 in find_tools' top 5; held-out paraphrases 16 → 36 of 42 after a rewrite the held-out check itself forced. Must NOT include a scorer change — two were tried, measured neutral and worse, and reverted. Sequence 416 follows epoch:find-tools-scores-what-a-query-means (415).
